table_defs: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gd_patch_registry (patch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, file TEXT, run_id TEXT, content_hash_before TEXT, content_hash_after TEXT, applied_at TEXT, skipped_reason TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auto_heal_actions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, timestamp TEXT, tool TEXT, action TEXT, file_path TEXT, line_number INTEGER, before_line TEXT, after_line TEXT, success INTEGER DEFAULT 0, error_message TEXT, iteration INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_runs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, start_time TEXT NOT NULL, end_time TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'running', iteration_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, errors_found INTEGER DEFAULT 0, errors_fixed INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS syntax_errors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, file_path TEXT NOT NULL, line_number INTEGER, error_text TEXT, code_line TEXT, context TEXT, fixed_ts TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verification_results (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT, tool_name TEXT, exit_code INTEGER, stdout TEXT, stderr TEXT, errors_found INTEGER DEFAULT 0, verified_at TEXT)

recovery.method: safe_query() wraps all queries with try/except and auto-recovery
recovery.code:
def safe_query(sql, params=()):
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH))
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(sql, params)
        result = cursor.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return result
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:
        log_verbatim(f'Database error, recovering...')
        ensure_database()
        conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH))
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute(sql, params)
        result = cursor.fetchall()
        conn.close()
        return result

verification.method: Every database operation is verified by checking rowcount or result
